notes.title: Usage, not seats alone
notes.body: Seats cover access; messages and agent runs are metered. The dashboard shows both as they accrue.

notes.title: No surprise bills
notes.body: Hit the monthly cap and runs pause cleanly rather than silently overrunning your budget.

notes.title: Move plans anytime
notes.body: Upgrade, downgrade or top up usage per person. Annual billing saves roughly 20%.

items.question: What counts as a message?
items.answer: One question and its answer, including the retrieval and any tool calls the agent made to produce it. A multi-step agent run counts as one message plus its tool usage.

items.question: What happens when I run out of monthly usage?
items.answer: Runs pause cleanly. You can top up on Pro and above, upgrade the plan, or wait for the next cycle — Ragenta never silently overruns your budget.

items.question: Do you train models on our data?
items.answer: No. Your documents and conversations are used to serve your workspace and nothing else. Enterprise plans can pin inference to a private deployment so content never leaves your network.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or move between monthly and annual billing at any time. Annual saves roughly 20% against month-to-month.

items.question: How are documents counted?
items.answer: By source document, not by chunk. A 400-page PDF is one document however many chunks it produces.

items.question: How does Enterprise pricing work?
items.answer: Enterprise is scoped per deployment — usage allocation, security review, data residency and invoice billing. Contact us and we will size it with you.

lifecycle.title: The whole loop, in one system
lifecycle.subtitle: Ingest, retrieve, evaluate — and the evaluation feeds back into the first two.
lifecycle.planBody: Connect a source and Ragenta parses layout, chunks on structure, embeds and keeps it in sync — with the source's permissions attached.
planSteps: Chunk — on structure, not character count
lifecycle.designBody: Vector similarity and keyword matching run together, then a reranker orders what actually reaches the model's context.
lifecycle.validateBody: Groundedness, citation coverage and retrieval hit rate are scored on every change, so a regression surfaces before a user reports it.

items.title: Enterprise search
items.blurb: One search box across every system, answering in sentences instead of link lists.
items.challenge: Knowledge is spread across a wiki, a drive, a ticket system and three chat workspaces. People give up before they find it.
items.solution: Ragenta indexes all of them into one permission-aware knowledge base and answers the question directly, with the passage it used attached.

items.title: Research assistant
items.blurb: Broad questions answered across many sources, with the evidence laid out.
items.challenge: Answering "what do we know about X" means reading twenty documents and hoping nothing was missed.
items.solution: An agent fans out across sources, covers each facet of the question, and shows which source supports which part of the answer.

items.title: Support deflection
items.blurb: Resolve repeat questions in-channel, escalate the rest with context attached.
items.challenge: Most tickets are answered by an article that already exists — but customers do not find it and agents retype it.
items.solution: A grounded agent answers from your help centre and policies, cites the article, and escalates with a summary when confidence is low.

items.title: RFPs & security questionnaires
items.blurb: Reuse every answer your team has already approved.
items.challenge: Each questionnaire repeats questions answered five times before, and the approved wording lives in someone's inbox.
items.solution: Ragenta matches each question to a previously approved answer with its source, and drafts only the genuine gaps for review.

items.title: IT & HR helpdesk
items.blurb: Policy answers in Slack, without exposing what the asker cannot see.
items.challenge: HR and IT answer the same policy questions constantly, and the source of truth changes without anyone noticing.
items.solution: Retrieval inherits each source's permissions, so an answer is assembled only from documents that person could already open.

items.title: Analytics agent
items.blurb: Ask a metric question in words, get the query, the numbers and the caveats.
items.challenge: Every ad-hoc metric question becomes a ticket for the data team, and the backlog decides what gets answered.
items.solution: The agent writes read-only SQL against approved tables, runs it, and explains the result alongside the query it used.

items.title: Contract review
items.blurb: Every clause compared against your playbook, deviations ranked by risk.
items.challenge: First-pass review is slow, repetitive, and the thing that gets skipped when a deal is urgent.
items.solution: Ragenta parses the agreement into clauses, compares each against your standard position, and ranks deviations by exposure.

items.title: Compliance reporting
items.blurb: Evidence packages assembled from the systems of record.
items.challenge: Audit season means chasing screenshots and policy versions across half a dozen tools.
items.solution: An agent gathers the evidence, maps it to each control, and produces the package with a link to every underlying document.
